name: CRITERIA1D-GEO V2.0.6
body:
### Installation (Windows and MacOS)
1) Download [CRITERIA1D_WIN64](https://github.com/ARPA-SIMC/CRITERIA1D/releases/download/v2.0.6/CRITERIA1D_WIN64.zip) (Windows x64) or [CRITERIA1D_MACOS (v.1.8.2)](https://github.com/ARPA-SIMC/CRITERIA1D/releases/download/v1.8.2/CRITERIA1D_MACOS.zip) (MAC OS, old version v1.8.2).
2) Unzip the CRITERIA1D folder to your local path (e.g. C:/SOFTWARE/CRITERIA1D).
3) Run the executables located in the bin directory.

### Executables
- CRITERIA1D_PRO (GUI)
- CRITERIA1D (shell)
- CRITERIA_GEO
- HEAT1D
- SOIL_EDITOR

### Documents
[Description](https://github.com/ARPA-SIMC/CRITERIA1D/blob/master/README.md)
[Technical manual](https://github.com/ARPA-SIMC/CRITERIA1D/blob/master/DOC/CRITERIA1D_technical_manual.pdf)
[Slope stability](https://github.com/ARPA-SIMC/CRITERIA1D/blob/master/DOC/CRITERIA1D_article.pdf)
[Bibliography](https://www.arpae.it/it/temi-ambientali/meteo/scopri-di-piu/strumenti-di-modellistica/criteria/criteria-bibliografia)

### Test data
+ Test project:  CRITERIA1D/DATA/PROJECT/test/test.ini  
+ Slope stability test:  CRITERIA1D/DATA/PROJECT/montue/montue.ini
+ Soil test db (for SOIL_EDITOR.exe):  CRITERIA1D/DATA/SOIL/soil_test_fitting.db  
+ Heat test data (for HEAT1D.exe):  CRITERIA1D/DATA/HEAT1D_EXPERIMENTS/
